_description: Deterministic routing rules for MIKA AGENTIC OS. Each taskType maps to a primary agent, fallback agent, approval rules, and execution constraints. Source of truth for dispatchTask.js.

routes.notes: Hermes is the primary research engine. OpenClaw is a capable fallback for summarization.
Deep market research. Hermes handles cross-brand research queries. Routes to OpenClaw if Hermes is unavailable.
Trend Hunter scans platforms for emerging patterns. Staged — falls back to Hermes for manual research.
Hook Engineer generates scroll-stopping openings. Staged — falls back to Hermes for freeform generation.
Content Architect builds full scripts and outlines. Staged — falls back to Hermes for basic script drafting.
Creative Director develops high-level concepts and brand voice alignment. Requires approval — strategy decisions affect multiple pieces. Staged.
Prompt Engineer generates AI image and video prompts. Staged — no provider connected yet. Falls back to Visual Designer.
Content Architect handles content repurposing across formats. Staged. Falls back to Hermes for cross-format adaptation.
Editor assembles and copy-edits final content before the Publisher schedules it. Requires approval before any publishing action. Staged.
Analytics Agent reviews platform performance and recommends repurposing. Staged — falls back to Hermes for manual data summarization.
Claude Code is the designated senior engineer. STAGED — do not connect programmatically until auth pattern is established. All code changes require human review before deploy.
Codex provides independent code review. STAGED — not yet connected. Falls back to Claude Code if available. Both require human approval before any changes land.
Hermes serves as the knowledge agent — research, summarize, and document to vault. OpenClaw handles vault writes.
OpenClaw is the Chief Orchestrator for all operations tasks — health checks, monitoring, routing, status synthesis.
OpenClaw synthesizes revenue strategy from agent data. Recovery handles lead reactivation. All revenue decisions require Mika approval.
Generic content task. Routes to Hermes for drafting. For studio-specific content, use a more specific task type (Script Creation, Hook Creation, etc.).
Recovery agent handles WhatsApp and email lead reactivation sequences. Always requires approval — direct contact with leads.
Automation setup and management routed through OpenClaw. Requires approval before any new automation is activated.
Client-facing deliverables always require human approval before sending. OpenClaw synthesizes and formats.
System maintenance tasks are handled by OpenClaw. Always requires approval — maintenance can affect running systems.
Architecture analysis — Claude Code (activated via gate) reviews and proposes architecture decisions. Falls back to Hermes if Claude Code is not yet activated. Analysis-only: no file writes.
Code review — Claude Code provides detailed feedback on code quality, patterns, and improvements. Falls back to Hermes. Analysis-only: no file writes.
Refactor planning — Claude Code produces a detailed refactor plan with risks and sequencing. Recommendations only — no auto-apply. Falls back to Hermes.
Bug diagnosis — Claude Code investigates bugs and suggests root causes and fixes. Never applies fixes automatically. Falls back to Hermes.
